title: Top K Frequent Elements - Solution
approach: Frequency map + min-heap size K filter.
intuition: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the k most frequent elements. You may return the answer in any order.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
optimized_approach: Frequency map + min-heap size K filter.
common_mistakes: Count element frequencies first. Push pairs of (freq, element) to min-heap of size k.
